name: omarchy-promo
description: Video promocional de los temas de Omarchy de thealejandro y omarchy-island (Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render Promo out/omarchy-promo.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/finish.sh out/omarchy-promo.raw.mp4 out/omarchy-promo.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render PromoVertical out/omarchy-promo-vertical.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/finish.sh out/omarchy-promo-vertical.raw.mp4 out/omarchy-promo-vertical.mp4
scripts.poster: remotion still Poster out/poster.png && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/poster.png -q:v 2 out/poster.jpg && rm out/poster.png
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run render:vertical && npm run poster
